dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Brave adventurer, are you ready to operate the Wenutslayer Cannon?

response.speaker: Vinayak
response.text: Alright! Sandstorm's whipping up now. Everyone to your positions!

response.speaker: Vinayak
response.text: Alright then. Planning ahead is good for efficiency, after all. But don't spend all your time planning and not executing, like some people.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: Hey! What's that supposed to mean!? Are you itching for another debate? I'll prove you wrong, I will!
